WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id < 900
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id < 900
)
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) AS gross_margin
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 10 AND 12 AND cs.region = 'South'
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 15

WITH rng AS (SELECT MIN(calendar_date) a, MAX(calendar_date) b FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 10 AND 12),
sl AS (SELECT f.* FROM fact_sales_line f, rng WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN rng.a AND rng.b),
dups AS (SELECT receipt_id, line_no, COUNT(*) c FROM sl GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING COUNT(*)>1),
dupid AS (SELECT sales_line_id, COUNT(*) c FROM sl GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1),
rd AS (SELECT return_line_id, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_return_line r, rng WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN rng.a AND rng.b GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1),
rs AS (SELECT sales_line_id, COUNT(*) c FROM fact_return_line r, rng WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN rng.a AND rng.b GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)
SELECT (SELECT a FROM rng) a, (SELECT b FROM rng) b, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sl) lines, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dups) dup_receipt_line, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dupid) dup_id,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rd) dup_return_id, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rs) multi_returns_per_line,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sl WHERE etl_loaded_at IS NULL) null_etl, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(etl_loaded_at AS DATE)) FROM sl) etl_days,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sl WHERE net_amount<=0 OR quantity<=0) nonpos,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT sku FROM dim_product WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1 HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) multi_current

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id < 900
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id < 900
),
mine AS (
  SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine
  FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 10 AND 12
  GROUP BY 1),
ctl AS (SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS ctl FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-27' AND DATE '2025-04-27' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.region, m.mine, c.ctl, m.mine - c.ctl AS gap
FROM dim_store cs LEFT JOIN mine m USING (store_id) LEFT JOIN ctl c USING (store_id)
WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.region IN ('South') OR cs.store_id IN (SELECT store_id FROM dim_store WHERE region='South')
ORDER BY 1

WITH net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id < 900
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND s.store_id < 900
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost) DESC) AS rank, cp.sku, cp.product_name, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales - n.cost), 2) AS gross_margin
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
JOIN dim_store cs ON cs.store_id = n.store_id AND cs.is_current
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 10 AND 12 AND cs.region = 'South'
GROUP BY cp.sku, cp.product_name
ORDER BY gross_margin DESC
LIMIT 10
